sourceVerdict: Six deterministic source findings recorded. No source remediation, runtime, native, full-page or physical power-flow acceptance.
purpose: Review Tesla Energy live power, stored energy, battery SOC, solar charging advice and selected-window historical observations.
primaryGoal: Distinguish measured W from stored Wh, signed import/export and charging/discharging from unknown readings, and trustworthy current evidence from retained or modeled advice.

unitAndPhysicsReview.powerVsEnergy: Page knownNumber inputs and chart series remain raw W. Energy props use wh for stored Wh, never integrate W samples into invented Wh. SOC is dimensionless percent and advice amperage is A.
unitAndPhysicsReview.display: helpers.ts:12-16 fmtWatts auto-scales W/kW; Energy.tsx:18-40 derives readable Wh/kWh. Unit arithmetic stays at the render boundary. No new legacy converter introduced.
unitAndPhysicsReview.preferences: Page and PowerHistoryChart subscribe to useNumberFormatting; fmtWatts respects current locale/precision. Energy also subscribes. SOC history uses a raw template string and omits preferences; F05. useUnits.ts:71-80 centralizes fixed defaults kWh/kW, not currently selectable power/energy preferences; no nonexistent user-unit bug promoted.
unitAndPhysicsReview.unknownVsZero: knownNumber leaves unknown scalar measurements null. fmtWatts and Energy render dash for missing/nonfinite readings, while actual0 displays0. Nullable SOC uses LinearGauge missing display rather than a zero meter. Grid/boolean unknown states are explicit.
unitAndPhysicsReview.batteryDirection: Page:183-188: batteryW<0 Charging, batteryW>0 Discharging, zero/null no direction; FlowArrow reverses its visual glyph according to sign.
unitAndPhysicsReview.gridDirection: Page:189-194: gridW>0 Importing, gridW<0 Exporting, zero/null no direction.
unitAndPhysicsReview.accessibilityDirection: Current FlowArrow:57 signed fmtWatts accessible group name,82 sr-only supplied direction; visible magnitude is aria-hidden. Historical missing-sign finding is not promoted again.
unitAndPhysicsReview.topology: Solar/Home, Battery/Home, Grid/Home labels describe source-level net readings. They are not evidence of branch-specific routing, conservation or measured physical connectivity; C03.
unitAndPhysicsReview.modeling: Advice verdict/surplus/recommended A come from server DTO. No control submission, generated telemetry, hidden model execution or energy physics experiment performed. snapshot_age_s/explanation are unused; F03.
unitAndPhysicsReview.provenance: Live/historical source descriptors and current-power snapshot label exist. Retained readings are nonfatally warned. fetched_at is not displayed. History lacks explicit chart range/timezone/source metadata; grouped context limitation in F01/F04.

findings.detail: History consumes calendar start/end rather than startInstant/endInstantExclusive. The precise rolling-window endpoint and timezone-aware exclusive end produced by the shared owner never reach the hook.
findings.mechanism: Destructured start:since,end:until feed URLSearchParams unchanged. Selecting24h/live can change precise instants while transmitted date pair remains unchanged; inclusive endDate is not an exclusive bound.

steps: At /power-flow select header24h, then inspect shared range result and hook arguments.
Compare start/end calendar strings with startInstant/endInstantExclusive ISO values.
Observe source only passes calendar strings; advance within same calendar dates to see same cache-key bounds despite changing rolling window.

findings.fix: Parent assigns page+typed-hook/integration ownership to pass both precise instants and verify server filtering/inclusivity; preserve header ownership and all regions.
findings.limits: Actual server filtering and result mismatch NOTRUN; defect here is missing precise frontend propagation, not an invented backend result.

findings.detail: Independent advice query consumes only data and returns null for absent/no_data, conflating loading, initial pause, fatal error, unresolved and authoritatively empty. It also retains cached advice without refresh-error/pause warning or retry.
findings.mechanism: No data-state hook or query error/loading/fetchStatus/refetch use; page dataSources registers only live/history. Live-source state cannot stand in for this different request.

steps: Resolve live/history normally but leave advice query pending, paused or failed without data.
Advice contributes no visible source shell/state/retry.
Retain a successful verdict then set advice refresh error: same recommendation remains with no advice-specific trust downgrade.

findings.fix: Preserve the advice region and model output; use existing state/feedback APIs for this independent query, including retained-warning and advice retry. Do not gate neighboring content.
findings.owner: battery feature direct component + parent integration

findings.detail: Advice displays charge_now/soon/wait plus solar-matched amperage, but never exposes snapshot_age_s or explanation. Explicit refresh success invalidates live/history but not advice, so recommendation provenance can remain different from the freshly shown live snapshot.
findings.mechanism: Only verdict, surplus_w and recommended_amps are consumed; model age/reason are not rendered and advice key is absent from mutation invalidation.

steps: Use valid advice charge_now with snapshot_age_s=600 and an explanation; compare rendered source fields.
Age/reason have no rendered path, regardless of their supplied values.
After source-defined refresh success, inspect invalidation keys: live/history only, not tesla-charge-advice.

findings.fix: Show available model age/reason/provenance without inventing a validity threshold; parent domain owner decides freshness policy and coherent refresh invalidation. Recommendation remains read-only.
findings.owner: battery feature + shared consumed hook integration
findings.limits: No unsafe device action or incorrect physical recommendation claimed; this is missing supplied trust context, not physics validation.

findings.detail: Both charts pass bare ChartTooltip while X uses epoch-ms time. Default tooltip converts numeric labels to raw strings, not dates. Series supply no unit/value formatter, so hover power values lack W/kW and SOC lacks percent even though axes/table provide specialized labels.
findings.mechanism: DefaultLabelFormatter recognizes ISO strings only; numeric time falls through String(label). DefaultValueFormatter appends a unit only when supplied. Chart areas/line have no unit and Tooltip no formatter.

steps: Use a valid history timestamp and solar=2000W,SOC=75.
Inspect default tooltip path for the epoch numeric label and payload entries.
Expected source-derived text is raw epoch and number-only2000/75, unlike specialized axes/table2kW/75%.

findings.fix: At these chart callsites provide existing label/value formatters with locale/timezone and actual W/% units; preserve raw W/SOC for chart/export data.
findings.owner: battery power-flow chart components; no shared tooltip rewrite needed

findings.detail: SOC formatter interpolates `${value}%` directly, bypassing existing locale/precision. Its axis and fallback-table cells therefore do not follow the subscribed numeric formatter used elsewhere on this page.
findings.mechanism: formatSocPercentTick only finite-checks then template-string converts; BatterySocChart does not subscribe to useNumberFormatting.

Compare with subscribed current SOC gauge formatting; no runtime preference test executed.

findings.fix: Use existing numeric formatting subscription in the component and preserve finite/null guard plus raw SOC values.

findings.detail: No-retained-data initial pause or idle-pending state is not loading under the page's isLoading-only guards, yet local live cards and both charts render no-data/empty messages before a successful empty response.
findings.mechanism: DataState retains initial/isRefreshBlocked for such a query. Page tests only !hasData&&query.isLoading, then !live or rows.length===0. Shared notice correctly labels paused/pending, but does not prevent contradictory local resolved-empty copy.

steps: Use a legitimate first-load query state data=undefined,isPending=true,isLoading=false,fetchStatus=paused,error=null.
Source DataState is initial with blocked refresh; no fatalError.

Live cards choose No battery/site/flow data and history charts choose No data available. Page notice separately reports pause, so the entire page is not blank and is not falsely treated as a server fatal error.

findings.fix: Retain separate region shells and source-specific paused/unresolved presentation; reserve authoritatively empty messages for resolved empty sources, without dropping retained payloads.
findings.owner: page-local state orchestration; existing shared APIs should be reused
